dialogue.content: (こんにちは。よろしくお願いいたします。お時間になったら始めさせていただきますね)
dialogue.English: (Hello. It's nice to meet you. We'll start when it's time.)

dialogue.content: (こんにちは。こちらこそよろしくお願い致します)
dialogue.English: (Hello. It's nice to meet you too.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。年齢、性別、ご相談内容を教えていただいてよろしいですか。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming today. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 22歳男性。就職活動をしなければならないけど、引きこもりがちです。
dialogue.English: I'm a 22-year-old male. I have to look for a job, but I tend to be a bit of a shut-in.

dialogue.content: やらなければいけないと思うけど、毎日退屈です。
dialogue.English: I know I have to do it, but every day feels boring.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。就職活動をしたいけどなかなか前に進めない感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you want to look for a job, but you feel like you can't really move forward?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: That's right...

dialogue.content: 前に進むにはとても勇気が入りますよね
dialogue.English: It takes a lot of courage to move forward, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 色々当たってはいますが、全然出来てません
dialogue.English: I've been trying various things, but I'm not getting anywhere at all.

dialogue.content: 勇気ですか…どうなんだろう?
dialogue.English: Courage, huh… I’m not sure.

dialogue.content: 気合かな?
dialogue.English: Maybe it's more about motivation?

dialogue.content: まだ就活していないかと思いました。
dialogue.English: I thought you hadn't started job hunting yet.

dialogue.content: 出来てないです
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to.

dialogue.content: エントリーシートとかなかなか書けなくて
dialogue.English: I can't seem to write things like entry sheets.

dialogue.content: まとまらないです
dialogue.English: I can’t organize my thoughts.

dialogue.content: エージェント登録とかしてみたけど、全然音沙汰ないです。
dialogue.English: I tried registering with a recruitment agent, but I haven't heard anything back.

dialogue.content: いろいろあたってるとおっしゃてるので前むきですね。
dialogue.English: Since you said you're trying various things, it sounds like you're being proactive.

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: でも、結果に繋がらないというか…
dialogue.English: But it's not leading to any results...

dialogue.content: エントリーシート書くの難しいですよね。希望の職種がありますか？
dialogue.English: Writing an entry sheet is difficult, isn't it? Is there a specific type of job you're hoping for?

dialogue.content: とりあえず営業かな
dialogue.English: Sales, for now, I guess.

dialogue.content: 男性だし、そんな方が採用されやすいと思って。
dialogue.English: Since I’m male, I thought that might make it easier to get hired.

dialogue.content: え！少し驚きました。
dialogue.English: Oh! I’m a bit surprised.

dialogue.content: なんでですか?
dialogue.English: Why is that?

dialogue.content: 引きこもりがちとおっしゃっていたので、、ご相談者様は意外とお話がすきのかなと、、
dialogue.English: You mentioned you tend to be a shut-in, so I thought perhaps you surprisingly enjoy talking to people.

dialogue.content: 事務職は女性多いし、WEB関係はプログラミングとか知っとかないと難しいし、とりあえず。
dialogue.English: Administrative jobs have a lot of women, and web-related jobs are difficult if you don't know programming, so sales was just a default choice.

dialogue.content: 引きこもりと話が好きって関係あるんですか?
dialogue.English: Is there a connection between being a shut-in and liking to talk?

dialogue.content: 営業をやりたいわけではないんですか？
dialogue.English: So it's not that you particularly want to do sales?

dialogue.content: とりあえず就職できれば何でも
dialogue.English: For now, as long as I can get a job, anything is fine.

dialogue.content: お金稼いで、早く家を出たいんです。
dialogue.English: I want to earn money and leave home as soon as possible.

dialogue.content: やりたい仕事っていうより、就職出来ればいいかなって感じです。
dialogue.English: It's less about a job I want to do, and more about just getting hired.

dialogue.content: 営業のお仕事ってお話ししないとならないじゃないですか。家をでたいんですか？
dialogue.English: A sales job involves a lot of talking, doesn't it? Do you want to leave home?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 両親とあまり折り合いよくないんで。
dialogue.English: I don’t get along very well with my parents.

dialogue.content: 大学はお金出してもらうから、家からにしたけど、就職は出たいです。
dialogue.English: They're paying for my university, so I stayed at home, but I want to move out when I get a job.

dialogue.content: ご両親とどんなことが合わないかおしえていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what it is you and your parents don't get along about?

dialogue.content: 昔からです。あてになりません。
dialogue.English: It's been like that for a long time. I can't rely on them.

dialogue.content: どのようなことでしょう？
dialogue.English: In what way?

dialogue.content: どのような事とは?
dialogue.English: What do you mean by "in what way"?

dialogue.content: あてにならないと、、
dialogue.English: You said you can't rely on them...

dialogue.content: 何か我慢されてらっしゃるんですか？
dialogue.English: Is there something you’ve been putting up with?

dialogue.content: こちらが望んでも、希望通りの反応がなかったり、動いてくれなかったり、そんな感じです。
dialogue.English: Even when I ask for something, they don't react the way I hope, or they don't take action. It's like that.

dialogue.content: 就職先も、最初はどこか紹介してくれるような口ぶりだったけど、結局そういう話も無くなって。
dialogue.English: With my job search too, at first they spoke as if they would introduce me to a place, but in the end, that talk just disappeared.

dialogue.content: やる気ないです。
dialogue.English: I’ve lost motivation.

dialogue.content: ご相談者様が思っていらっしゃるように親御さんが動いてくれないとがっかりしますよね。具体的なお話をきかせてもらってもいいですか？
dialogue.English: It must be disappointing when your parents don't act the way you hope they would. Could you tell me more specifics?

dialogue.content: 就職先を探してくれていたんですね。でもなくなってしまったんですか、、
dialogue.English: They were looking for a job for you, but it fell through...

dialogue.content: 親の知り合いの会社へ口利きしてくれる話があって、2ヶ月前に決まりかけていたんです
dialogue.English: There was talk of them putting in a good word for me at a company an acquaintance owns, and it was almost decided two months ago.

dialogue.content: でも、先方から断られて。
dialogue.English: But the company turned it down.

dialogue.content: 更に関係が深い所から採るみたいな話でした。
dialogue.English: It sounded like they were going to hire someone with an even closer connection.

dialogue.content: がっかりしました。
dialogue.English: I was disappointed.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それでご自分で探されている。でもなかな決まらないということ、、
dialogue.English: I see. And so now you're looking on your own. But you're not having much luck...

dialogue.content: 期待させて落とす。親はそんな所があります
dialogue.English: They get my hopes up and then let me down. My parents can be like that.

dialogue.content: 周りからもほぼ決まったと思われてたから、大学も行きにくい。
dialogue.English: Everyone around me thought it was a sure thing, so it's hard to go to university now.

dialogue.content: 職業が決まりかけていたのに、お断りされてしまってショックでしたね。
dialogue.English: It must have been a shock to be turned down when the job was almost secured.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 大学行きにくいですか？
dialogue.English: Is it hard to go to campus?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やる気が出ません
dialogue.English: I can't find any motivation.

dialogue.content: 大体今頃はほとんど内定出てるし。話合わないですよ
dialogue.English: By this time of year, most people already have job offers. I can't relate to their conversations.

dialogue.content: みじめになるばっかりです
dialogue.English: I just end up feeling miserable.

dialogue.content: どーなるんすかね、これから。
dialogue.English: I wonder what's going to happen to me from now on.

dialogue.content: 毎日ただ時間が過ぎるだけです。
dialogue.English: Every day, time just passes by.

dialogue.content: ご相談者様なら今お話をした感じだととてもきちんと自分の意見を述べられているとおもいます。
dialogue.English: From the way you've spoken with me now, I think you're very capable of expressing your own opinions clearly.

dialogue.content: これから二次募集もありますよ。
dialogue.English: There will be second-round recruitment periods from now on, you know.

dialogue.content: でも、就職活動でこんな事言えないですよね
dialogue.English: But I can't say things like this during my job hunt, can I?

dialogue.content: 二次募集か…あるのかな。
dialogue.English: Second-round recruitment... I wonder if there will be any.

dialogue.content: 就職して働く。ことが目的なのですから
dialogue.English: The goal is to get a job and work, after all.

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: I guess so...

dialogue.content: そうしないと、家も出れないし。
dialogue.English: If I don't, I can't leave home.

dialogue.content: 働くというより、家を出る方が重要なのかもしれないです。
dialogue.English: Maybe leaving home is more important to me than working.

dialogue.content: お家も出て自立したいけどなんて、とっても立派なことだと思い私は感心しました。親の脛をかじって生きてるかたが多い世の中なのに。
dialogue.English: Wanting to leave home and become independent is a very admirable thing. I'm impressed, especially in a world where so many people live off their parents.

dialogue.content: 一緒にいるのが嫌だからです。
dialogue.English: It's just because I don't want to be with them.

dialogue.content: それでも自立だと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: Even so, I think that's still independence.

dialogue.content: 就職は家を出るための手段で、他にあれば、別の方法で出たいです。
dialogue.English: Getting a job is just a means to leave home. If there were another way, I'd prefer that.

dialogue.content: 他に何かよい案あるんですか？教えてもらってもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any other good ideas? Could you share them with me?

dialogue.content: わからないです。
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 立派なんかじゃないです。ファンタジーかよ。
dialogue.English: It’s not admirable at all. As if—that’s a fantasy.

dialogue.content: 就職以外で、家出る方法って、何か思い浮かびますか?
dialogue.English: Besides getting a job, can you think of any other way to leave home?

dialogue.content: どうしても、ご相談者様は家からでたいのですね。
dialogue.English: You really want to leave home, no matter what, don't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学生の間は、お金出してもらってるからまだ我慢できるけど、
dialogue.English: While I'm a student, I can still put up with it because they're paying for me, but...

dialogue.content: 一番どの様にしていえをでるのがいいとおもいますか。
dialogue.English: What do you think is the best way to leave home?

dialogue.content: 就職が手っ取り早い感じがしてます。
dialogue.English: Getting a job seems like the quickest way.

dialogue.content: やっぱり、就職ですね。
dialogue.English: So, it comes back to getting a job, then.

dialogue.content: 生活するのにお金いるし
dialogue.English: I need money to live.

dialogue.content: そうですね。お金が必要ですよね。
dialogue.English: That’s right. You do need money.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 就職先さがしますか？
dialogue.English: Shall we look for a job?

dialogue.content: 頭ではわかってるんだけど、なかなか動けません。
dialogue.English: I know it in my head, but I just can't bring myself to act.

dialogue.content: だから、相談にきました。
dialogue.English: That's why I came for counseling.

dialogue.content: 焦らず、ゆっくり探してみたらだめでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What if you tried looking slowly, without rushing?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですかね…それで?
dialogue.English: Will that be okay... if I do that?

dialogue.content: 家をでる事を目的として、ある程度お金を貯めてからでもおそくないのでは？
dialogue.English: If your goal is to move out, it wouldn’t be too late to save up some money first, would it?

dialogue.content: 貯めるには働かないといけないですよね
dialogue.English: I have to work to save money, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 大きな企業へ就職されたいのですか？
dialogue.English: Do you want to get a job at a large company?

dialogue.content: 働く→就職→決まらない→家から出られないっていうのがぐるぐる回っています
dialogue.English: The cycle of "work -> get a job -> can't get hired -> can't leave home" is just spinning in my head.

dialogue.content: 企業が大きい方が、安全な気はします。すぐ潰れる事はないでしょうし。
dialogue.English: A bigger company feels safer. It probably won't go out of business right away.

dialogue.content: まず就職そして働くの順番は？
dialogue.English: What about the order of getting a job first, and then working?

dialogue.content: 順番が逆なんですか
dialogue.English: Is the order reversed?

dialogue.content: 確かに今はそうかも。
dialogue.English: You're right, maybe it is right now.

dialogue.content: 就職しないと。働けないのでは？
dialogue.English: Without getting a job, you can't work, right?

dialogue.content: あるかなー不安です
dialogue.English: I wonder if there will be any... I'm anxious.

dialogue.content: ご相談者様には自立するという決意があるではないですか！
dialogue.English: But you have the determination to be independent, don't you!

dialogue.content: はぁ
dialogue.English: Sigh.

dialogue.content: 不安持ちながら、動けますか?
dialogue.English: Can I take action while feeling anxious?

dialogue.content: なんのご不安ですか？
dialogue.English: What are you anxious about?

dialogue.content: 決まらなかったらどうしようという不安です。
dialogue.English: It's the anxiety of, "What if I don't get hired?"

dialogue.content: 行動にうつしてみたらいかがでしょう
dialogue.English: How about trying to take action?

dialogue.content: それも話したかったのに、なんか聞いても無駄みたいですね。もう終わっていいですか。
dialogue.English: I wanted to talk about that too, but it seems pointless asking you. Can we just end this now?

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました。お時間も過ぎてしまい申し訳ありませんでした。失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you very much. I'm sorry for going over our time. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （お時間過ぎてしまい申し訳ありませんでした。ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry for going over our time. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした。感想はレポートで書きます。終了しても🆗です)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. I'll write my impressions in the report. It's okay to end the session.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)
